selection_rule: First four lexicographic IDs in each original75 and new25 cohort; does not use method success or metric values. HN0004 is an already completed pilot, included by this rule. Replacement_v3 is a separate one-person stratum excluded from this bounded ablation.
source_frame_sampling: Original 25Hz exported frames with linear positions and existing runtime SPD covariance interpolation; no time rounding
failure_policy: Retain failed identity with cause; no score-based replacement or unbounded retry
reporting: Paired variants on common successful identities; report n/8, strata and per-person values; do not label this a 100-person ablation
